sections.heading: Our take on the RX 5700 XT
paragraphs: The RX 5700 XT is one of the older cards that still clears our lowest level, 1080p with low settings. In the 2023 test above it averaged 58 frames a second in Cyberpunk 2077 at 1080p on the highest settings, so it has some room once settings come down. Its real weakness for a 2026 game is that it has no ray tracing hardware at all, so any lighting GTA 6 builds on ray tracing would have to be switched off or run in a slower fallback.

sections.heading: Upscaling and frame generation
paragraphs: The RX 5700 XT supports AMD's FSR 1, 2 and 3, including FSR 3 frame generation. It does not get AMD's newer machine-learning upscaler, which AMD lists for RX 6000 cards and newer.
Whether GTA 6 on PC will include FSR has not been announced.

sections.heading: Against Rockstar's other PC games
paragraphs: Rockstar's most recent PC release is the 2025 enhanced version of GTA V. Its store page recommends an RTX 3060 or RX 6600 XT with 8 GB of video memory. On our own scoring the RX 5700 XT is about level with the RTX 3060.
Red Dead Redemption 2, released on PC in 2019, recommends a GTX 1060 6GB. GTA 6 is a newer and much larger game than either, so expect its requirements to be higher than both.

sections.heading: Is there a laptop RX 5700 XT?
paragraphs: No laptop chip is sold under this exact name, so a laptop listed with a similar-sounding graphics chip is a different part. Check the exact model name in the checker below.

sections.heading: Our take on the RTX 3050
paragraphs: The RTX 3050 is the slowest RTX card in our list and sits just above our lowest level. Its 8 GB of video memory is more than it can really use: in the 2023 test above it averaged 46 frames a second in Cyberpunk 2077 at 1080p and 28 at 1440p, so speed runs out before memory does. Expect 1080p, low settings and DLSS doing a lot of the work.

sections.heading: Upscaling and frame generation
paragraphs: The RTX 3050 supports DLSS Super Resolution, which draws the game at a lower resolution and sharpens it to your screen's resolution for more frames a second.
It does not support DLSS Frame Generation, which needs an RTX 40 card or newer.
Whether GTA 6 on PC will include DLSS has not been announced.
